newsitem.title: GREECE: GLORY OF BYZANTIUM GOES TO N.Y. METROPOLITAN MUSEUM.
newsitem.headline: GLORY OF BYZANTIUM GOES TO N.Y. METROPOLITAN MUSEUM.

text.p: More than 350 masterpieces of byzantine art will be exhibited in New York's Metropolitan Museum of Art from March 11 to July 6, it said in a statement.

The exhibit, titled "The glory of Byzantium" is the result of the combined effort and support of Alpha Credit Bank and Greece's ministry of culture. Other sponsors include Citibank and Papastratos, the museum said. --George Georgiopoulos, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
